limitations_noted: Development-only synthetic pilot artifact (ai2-pilot-source-v1); not verified employer competence, expert gold, or proof of production parser consistency.
Recurring candidate-index scenario templates across pilot jobs remain an accepted limitation under HR-SOURCE-009; candidate IDs and ordering must be excluded from features and label inference.

Presence-only skills and role skill arrays omit prose proficiency qualifiers such as '(cơ bản)' in IT-J07-C03 (PostgreSQL) and IT-J07-C08 (Java, Spring Boot); downstream annotation must read section prose.

Retained tenure/scope ambiguities under HR-SOURCE-008 (IT-J07-C04 1-year Java subset within 2022-03-to-present mixed .NET/Java role; IT-J07-C05 fullstack vs pure backend tenure; IT-J07-C03/C05 summary vs role details), IT-J07-C07-E02 unknown dates/status (is_current=null), and IT-J07-R01 Java-version-tenure phrasing ambiguity require careful downstream labeling and human review flagging when label-material.

Cross-corpus duplicate checks and exhaustive external collision verification for fictionalized organization names (such as VietPayLink, SafeLife, Y-Tech) remain coordinator scope; no external verification performed.
